email.subject.forgetPassword: Your Favorite Hearts account recovery code
email.code.ignore: If you did not request this, you can ignore this email.
email.warning.thisCode: Favorite Hearts staff will never ask you for this code. Do not share it with anyone.
email.warning.anyCode: Favorite Hearts staff will never ask you for any code. Do not share it with anyone.
email.warning.passwordOrCode: Favorite Hearts staff will never ask you for a password or a code.
email.sms.code: Favorite Hearts code: {code}. Expires in {codeMinutes} min. Never share it - our staff will never ask for it.
email.invitation.subject: {managerName} has started a Favorite Hearts matrimony profile for you
email.invitation.prepared: {managerName} has prepared a matrimony profile for you on Favorite Hearts and would like you to review it.
email.invitation.choices: You can accept and confirm it, decline it, or take it over and manage it yourself. Nothing is decided without you.
email.invitation.link: The link works once and expires in {hours} hours. When you open it we will send a code to this address to confirm it is you.
email.sms.invitation: {managerName} started a Favorite Hearts matrimony profile for you. Review, accept or decline within {hours}h: {link}
email.paymentApproved.subject: Your plan is active
email.paymentApproved.matched: We matched your payment {reference} in our account. {plan} is now active for {profile} until {endsAt}.
email.paymentApproved.unlocked: You can now send requests, see who sent you interest, and accept requests.
email.paymentRejected.subject: We could not confirm your payment
email.paymentRejected.notConfirmed: We could not confirm payment {reference} for {plan}.
email.paymentRejected.next: You can start a new payment from the plan page of the profile. If you think this is a mistake, reply to this email.
email.paymentHeld.subject: We need something more for your payment
email.paymentHeld.need: Before we can confirm payment {reference} for {plan}, we need the following:
email.paymentHeld.where: Add it on the plan page of the profile.
email.paymentRefunded.subject: Your payment was refunded
email.paymentRefunded.planEnded: The plan it paid for has ended.
email.renewalPending: We have your renewal payment and are checking it. Access continues for up to {renewalGraceDays} days after the end while we do.
email.planExpiring.subject: Your plan ends on {date}
email.planExpiring.afterwards: After that you will no longer see the contact details or social handles of anyone, including your connections. Your connections stay, and their details come back when you renew.
email.planExpiring.renew: You can renew the same plan in its last {renewalWindowDays} days, or upgrade at any time.
email.planEnded.subject: Your plan has ended
email.planEnded.hidden: Contact details and social handles are now hidden, including those of your connections. Your connections stay, and their details come back when you renew.
email.handedOver.subject: You now run your profile yourself
email.handedOver.managerDeleted: The family member who managed {profile} deleted their account, so the profile is now yours to run.
email.handedOver.handedOver: The family member who managed {profile} handed it over to you. You run it yourself from now on.
email.handedOver.stays: Its plan, requests and connections stay with the profile. Their contact details were removed from it.
email.handedOver.paused: It is paused until your own identity document is reviewed and your phone is verified. Then you can publish it again.
email.handedOver.check: Check the profile details and your privacy settings when you next sign in.
email.profileDeleted.subject: A profile you managed was deleted
email.profileDeleted.deleted: The candidate deleted {profile}, the profile you managed for them. It is no longer shown to anyone, and you no longer have access to it.
email.profileDeleted.kept: Some records, such as payments, are kept for a limited time, as our privacy policy explains.
